{{Quote|Ah, you must be Trademaster Kavork of the Red Meteor Consortium.|[[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Minister of Intelligence]], to [[Kavork]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Red Meteor Consortium''' was a pirate organization during the time of the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Ilum]], former [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Intelligence Minister]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] hired the Red Meteor Consortium pirates to raid a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] transport and capture the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite-frozen]] [[Shara Jenn]]. During the [[Revanite crisis]], the former [[Cipher Nine]] and former Minister of Intelligence went to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] to negociate the liberation of Shara Jenn with Trademaster [[Kavork]]. After Cipher Nine killed the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] pirate [[Boruush]], Kavork accepted to release Shara Jenn.<ref name="TOR" />
